author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: New pending reservations store an unused reservation timestamp.
findings.consequence: The field has no effect and misleadingly implies pending reservations are age-pruned.
findings.evidence: reservedAt is assigned and declared but never read; pruning uses acceptedAt and tests intentionally retain old pending reservations.
findings.recommendation: Remove reservedAt from pending reservation creation and type.
